description: Copy absolute, workspace, and Git repository paths or repository URLs from Explorer and editor tabs.
command.copyWorkspaceRelativePath: Copy Path Relative to Workspace Folder
command.copyRepositoryRelativePath: Copy Path Relative to Repository Root
command.copyRelativePathsMarkdown: Copy Relative Paths as Markdown List
configuration.remoteUrlFormat.markdownDe: Format used by **Copy Repository URL**. `https` converts common SSH remotes to browser-friendly HTTPS URLs; `preserve` copies the Git remote exactly as configured.
configuration.remoteName.description: Git remote name used by Copy Repository URL.
configuration.copyTemplates.markdownDesc: Custom entries shown in **Copy Path or Repository URL…**. Each entry requires `name` and `template`. Supported variables: `${absolutePath}`, `${fileName}`, `${path}`, `${workspacePath}`, `${repositoryPath}`, `${repoUrl}`, `${commit}`, `${line}`, and `${endLine}`. `${path}` is repository-relative when available, otherwise workspace-relative. Templates that need unavailable Git, workspace, or editor-line information are hidden.
